rules.title: Gradle caches
rules.why: Gradle's download and build cache; the next build fetches what it needs.

rules.title: Maven downloads
rules.why: Maven's local copy of downloaded libraries; builds download them again.

rules.title: npm cache
rules.why: npm's download cache, the same as `npm cache clean --force`.

rules.title: Yarn cache
rules.why: Yarn's download cache; installs fill it again.

rules.title: Bun cache
rules.why: Bun's package download cache; installs fill it again.

rules.title: Deno cache
rules.why: Deno's downloaded modules and compiled cache; regenerated on the next run.

rules.title: node-gyp headers
rules.why: Node.js headers node-gyp downloads to build native modules; fetched again when needed.

rules.title: pip cache
rules.why: pip's wheel and download cache, the same as `pip cache purge`.

rules.title: pre-commit hook environments
rules.why: Tool environments pre-commit installs for hooks; rebuilt on the next commit that needs them.

rules.title: CocoaPods cache
rules.why: CocoaPods' download cache; `pod install` fills it again.

rules.title: Swift Package Manager cache
rules.why: Cached package checkouts and manifests; SwiftPM re-fetches them.

rules.title: Go build cache
rules.why: Go's compiler cache, the same as `go clean -cache`.

rules.title: TypeScript editor cache
rules.why: Type definitions editors download for IntelliSense; fetched again on demand.

rules.title: Xcode cache
rules.why: Xcode's own cache folder; Xcode rebuilds it.

rules.title: Dart tool output
rules.why: Generated by Dart and Flutter tooling; `dart pub get` recreates it.
